visitors.name: Kit
visitors.quietLine: Kit grabs a marker and skips back down the hall. Your dragon didn't make a peep!
visitors.noisyLine: Squeak! "What was that?" Kit peeks around the door, curious.

choices.label: Tell Kit the secret
choices.result: Kit gasps... then pinky-promises to help keep the dragon safe. Kit joins the Keeper Circle!

choices.label: "It's a secret for now. I'll tell you soon, I promise."
choices.result: Kit squints at you. "Okay. Pinky promise!"

choices.label: "Can I have some quiet time, please?"

visitors.name: Mom
visitors.quietLine: Mom blows you a kiss and heads downstairs. All quiet!
visitors.noisyLine: Chirp! Mom tilts her head. "Did you hear something?"

choices.label: "Something's on my mind. Can we talk tomorrow?"
choices.result: Mom smiles. "Of course. Whenever you're ready."

choices.label: "Can I have a few minutes of quiet, please?"

visitors.name: Dad
visitors.quietLine: Dad yawns, smiles and closes the door. Goodnight!
visitors.noisyLine: Hiccup! Dad raises an eyebrow. "Was that a hiccup?"

choices.label: "There's something I want to tell you soon. Can it wait till tomorrow?"
choices.result: Dad nods. "Tomorrow it is. I'm proud of you."

choices.label: "I'm okay, just need some quiet. Goodnight!"

windowThings.tapLine: Just a moth, fluttering at the glass.
A drone with a red light that never blinks: it's BLINK, the collector's camera! You close the curtains.
windowThings.missLine: A red light hovered at the window... then zipped away.

windowThings.tapLine: It's Pickles, the neighbor's cat, out for a stroll.
A "wildlife surveyor" with a clipboard... in the dark? Suspicious! You close the curtains.
windowThings.missLine: Someone with a clipboard was peering at the house...

windowThings.tapLine: BLINK is back! Curtains closed. Nice spotting.
windowThings.missLine: BLINK's red light swept past the window.
